scope: Fit-only optimization sufficiency for all joint_bn/no_messages/no_latent_head estimators; no architecture, data, split or regularization changes.
selection: Continue if original optimizer failed OR fit-objective projected-gradient infinity norm exceeds tolerance.
acceptance: Keep the additional fit iff finite and its same fit objective does not increase; save every attempt regardless.
evaluation_order: Finish and freeze all training decisions before computing any new validation/test scores.
claim: Numerical stationarity diagnostic only, not global optimality or independent external validation.
